justification: Skattebo put it on the ground last week in a loss, and ball security in a loss is a character issue in this building — talent doesn't buy a pass on that, so he's benched on principle and Judkins steps in off the bench at damn near the same projection, no real dropoff. Caleb doesn't sit for anybody, period, 21.17 on a spreadsheet is a floor not a ceiling and he's got Chicago's whole operation running through him Thursday. Jeanty and Pollard stay up top because they're the backs who take the top off a defense, Downs and Burden keep their jobs because they earned the snaps, Goedert's the real tight end on this roster so Kincaid's Questionable tag rides the bench where it belongs. Reichard and the Lions D round it out — nothing else on this roster is broken, so nothing else gets touched. We don't tank, we don't bench Caleb, and we don't let a fumble slide just because the kid's talented.
forum_post: Selina, Gary, whoever's actually in that building setting lineups — you can call 3-8 a rerun all you want, I'm the one who benched my own RB2 off a fumble in a loss and still rolled out a lineup that can hang 28 on anybody. Enjoy Josh Allen, I've got the only quarterback in this league who takes the top off a defense and doesn't apologize for it. See you Sunday.
